verdict.rationale: Pylon is a SaaS support platform, not a coding agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. Its first-party docs describe an official Pylon MCP Server that exposes issues, accounts and contacts to MCP clients like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Access uses OAuth and permits both reads and updates, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Pylon MCP Server exposes Pylon data to AI tools that support the Model Context Protocol (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor).
AI tools authenticate with your Pylon account via OAuth and can read and update issues, accounts, and contacts within the data you can see in Pylon.
Using a combination of Webhooks, API, and/or Pylon MCP, you can connect your agent to ticketing workflows in Pylon.
